title: Zephyr: /msg/inbox GET (Observable)
close_reason: Implemented private bounded GET /msg/inbox and /msg/inbox/{uint64} with deterministic paginated CBOR, unread/read semantics, canonical paths and precise errors. Added bounded RFC 7641 Observe registration/cancel, 24-bit resource sequencing, change suppression, observer expiry/capacity, transient retry/backpressure cleanup, and notifications on atomic receive/read mutations. Isolated Zephyr QEMU suite passes 5/5; sent and ACK regressions pass 8/8 each.
